app.title: Elixir HLS makes FPGA circuits from functions written in Elixir
app.description: A compiler that translates Elixir functions into High‑Level Synthesis (HLS) code for generating FPGA circuits.
proposed_tests: Clone repo and run `mix compile` to build the compiler
Create a minimal Elixir module and compile it to VHDL using the tool
Verify the generated VHDL contains the expected logic gates
Run the generated VHDL through a simulator and check functional correctness
